page_title: FUL 3-1 BOU | Fulham v Bournemouth 10/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+6' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Bernd Leno scrambling, but it flies just over the bar.
90+4' Yellow card. Harry Wilson (Fulham) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
90+4' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 7:24.
90+4' Handball by Lewis Cook (Bournemouth).
90+2' Romain Faivre (Bournemouth) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
90+2' The resulting corner from Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.

90+2' The linesman makes the right call and Bournemouth will have a corner. Enes Unal (Bournemouth) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
88' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle. That's a free kick to Fulham.
86' Fulham are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
85' Substitution. Adam Smith walks off the pitch and Romain Faivre (Bournemouth) comes on as a substitute.
85' Marco Silva decides to make a substitution. Andreas Pereira will be replaced by Fode Ballo-Toure (Fulham).
85' Substitution. Adama Traore (Fulham) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Willian walks off.
84' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
83' Armando Broja (Fulham) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Fulham will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
81' Adam Smith (Bournemouth) commits a nasty foul by bringing down his opponent.
80' Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
79' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Ryan Christie (Bournemouth), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
79' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Bournemouth, is intercepted by one of the defenders. Bournemouth force their opponents to concede a corner.
79' A player from Fulham commits a rough challenge. Darren England blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Bournemouth have a free kick.
77' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bournemouth.

77' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in. The ball is out of play. Bournemouth win a corner kick.
77' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play.
75' Rodrigo Muniz will be replaced by Armando Broja (Fulham).
74' Adam Smith (Bournemouth) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
73' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
73' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Corner kick. Bournemouth will have an opportunity.
73' Bournemouth control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
71' 0:8 – the corner kicks stats.
69' Andoni Iraola prepares a substitution. Luis Sinisterra is replaced by Enes Unal (Bournemouth).
69' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Marcus Tavernier walks off the pitch to be replaced by Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth).
68' Bernd Leno is equal to the effort from the edge of the box by Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth), pushing the ball around the post to safety.
68' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
67' The resulting corner from Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) comes to nothing. The ball goes out of play. Bournemouth are awarded a corner kick.
63' Andoni Iraola has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) replacing Alex Scott.
63' Tom Cairney comes off the pitch to be replaced by Harrison Reed (Fulham).
63' A substitution has been made. Bobby De Cordova-Reid goes off and Harry Wilson (Fulham) comes on.
62' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) is shown the yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. It could have been worse!
61' A dangerous looking corner kick from Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) is cleared to safety by the defence.

60' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. Bournemouth will have a chance to score from a corner.

60' The Fulham players are exchanging fine passes and are waiting for an opportunity to start an attack, but here's a mistake and a loss of possession. The ball is out of play. Bournemouth will have a throw-in.
59' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.
58' The ball is cleared after Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Bournemouth have been awarded a corner kick.

57' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) attempts to surprise the keeper with a shot from distance, but it lacks accuracy and goes high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
57' Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
54' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play.
52' 3 - 1 Goal! Willian puts a cross into the box and finds Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham), who latches on to it and strikes the ball into the top right corner. He makes it 3:1.
50' 2 - 1 Goal! Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) was in the right place at the right time to pounce on the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball home. It's 2:1.
50' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Bournemouth will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
46' The referee allows time for a substitution. Lloyd Kelly will be replaced by Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+8' Darren England blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+8' Luis Sinisterra (Bournemouth) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.
45+5' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Fulham.
45+4' Fulham are passing the ball across the pitch and keep possession. However, an opponent intercepts a pass and the situation changes. The ball is out of play. Fulham will take a throw-in.
45+3' A player from Bournemouth commits a rough challenge. Darren England blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
45+2' Willian (Fulham) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the area, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post.
45' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.

43' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) receives a quality pass and releases a rocket of a shot from distance, but his amazing effort goes just wide of the left post! The goalkeeper probably wouldn't have saved this one. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.
43' Great teamplay by Bournemouth as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
41' Luis Sinisterra (Bournemouth) plays a through ball but overhits it.

40' That was close by Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
36' 2 - 0 Goal! Bobby De Cordova-Reid gets to the ball and heads it over the defence to Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham), who meets it nicely and fires in into the back of the net. 2:0.
35' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Bournemouth.
34' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
33' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) receives a fine cross inside the box and attempts to score a goal, but his strike flies just a few inches over the bar.
32' The resulting corner from Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

31' A snap shot by Luis Sinisterra (Bournemouth) from the edge of the area flies towards the top left corner, but Bernd Leno produces a good save to thwart him. It will be a corner kick for Bournemouth.
31' Bournemouth keep the ball well and push forward with purpose, but here comes an interception from the opposition.
27' This shall not pass! Antonee Robinson (Fulham) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
27' The Fulham players are exchanging some short passes.

25' Luis Sinisterra (Bournemouth) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.
23' The Fulham players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
22' Darren England interrupts the game. One of the players from Bournemouth won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. It's a free kick to Fulham in a dangerous position.
21' Tom Cairney (Fulham) is able to continue to play.
20' Tom Cairney (Fulham) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
18' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal from a mid-range free kick, but the ball is blocked by the defensive wall.

17' Timothy Castagne (Fulham) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Bournemouth are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
15' Timothy Castagne (Fulham) sends a cross into the box, but Neto comes off his line to gather the ball.
14' Fulham enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.

6' 1 - 0 Goal! The ball breaks to Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham) after some poor defending, he finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and calmly puts the ball into the back of the net! He makes it 1:0.
6' The Fulham players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

4' Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Darren England with no other option than to blow for a foul. Free kick. Fulham will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.

The players are out at last! Bournemouth will take the kick-off.
Darren England is the one to supervise the game today.
